notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor building a native in-app assistant + semantic product search. Initially trialed Hosted API; strong interest in Dedicated for predictable cost and data isolation.

Timeline: 2024-08 — initial inbound trial (hosted API). 2024-09 — product demo; team requested lower-latency profile. 2024-10-10 — POC kickoff (hosted) focused on embeddings + chat flows. 2024-10-29 — POC embedding results uploaded (see drive). 2024-11-02 — pricing walk-through and Dedicated capability demo (FF-20241102-34a7).

POC findings: embeddings within expected recall for product search; chat latencies with hosted API average ~220ms 95p on standard model; customer target is sub-150ms 95p for primary support flows. Prefers quantized Llama-2/Redwood-curated model variant for cost/latency tradeoff.

Requirements summary: primary workload = in-product support agent + semantic search. Target latency = <=150ms (95p) for chat shadowing flows; throughput target = sustained 40-60 QPS for peak product events. Cost sensitivity = medium-high; wants unit economics predictable before rollout.

Initial ask (pricing/packaging): Sunward requested a 12-month Dedicated commitment with a 3-month ramp schedule, starting with 25% of committed capacity in months 1-3, 50% months 4-6, and full commit by month 7. Asked for burst allowance up to 2.5x base capacity for short spikes (no more than 48 hours per month).

Redwood proposal (v1): 12-mo term, $150k annual commit (base), burst allowed up to 2x at 25% premium on consumed tokens during burst windows, overage billed at 1.5x unit price beyond 100% of commit. Included 30 days notice requirement for sustained bursts over 2x. 10% onboarding credit and 60k free evaluation tokens for final POC months.

Negotiation notes: AE (Maya) escalated request to provide more favorable burst economics — Sunward pushed back on 25% premium during bursts; prefers capped overage with a monthly cap at 30% of committed spend and automated notifications when consumption >80% of commit. Legal asked for explicit data residency clause (US-only) and audit log retention 13 months.
Customer quote (CTO, paraphrased): "We need predictable unit cost as we scale; surprises on overage kill the ROI. If you can give us a clear ramp and a cap, we can commit to 12 months."

Outstanding commercial asks from Sunward: a) Lower burst premium (aiming for 10-15%), b) Hard overage cap (max 30% monthly overage charge), c) Ramp discounts: 50% of base rate months 1-3, 75% months 4-6 (they requested a stepped discount tied to commit ramp).

Operational asks: VPC peering (already validated with infra team), SOC2 report and ISO27001 roadmap, KMS integration (customer uses AWS KMS), SSO via SAML (Okta), and per-route throttling for different features (search vs chat).

Next technical steps: SE (Diego) to produce a latency/throughput estimate for dedicated pool size that meets 95p 150ms target for chat (deliver by 2024-11-12). Provide suggested quantization profile and expected GPU footprint for customer's traffic mix.

Next commercial steps: Create term sheet v2 incorporating: stepped ramp discounts, burst up to 2.5x at 15% premium capped by a 30% monthly overage ceiling, notification thresholds at 80% and 95%, and a 12-mo commit with mid-year renegotiation clause. Target signature by mid-November (forecast month 2024-11).
